item.title: Dragula: Suckin
item.description: By Zeno Park and Charlie Palmer Every college town has that one mysterious figure you only see after 2 a.m.: South Bend has that leprechaun, Columbus has some coked up homeless guy probably, and Ann Arbor has Dragula. But unlike those other freaks, she isn’t hiding in crypts. Instead, she’s haunting the karaoke bar. item.title: A Brief, Completely Accurate History of The Gargoyle
item.description: By Charlie Palmer Long before it was a magazine, The Gargoyle was a cave.
